title: DAY 1/90
GATE ME
scenes.voice: Day one of the GATE M. E. ninety days challenge starts today! One hundred and ten days to GATE. Let's start strong.

scenes.title: Today's Topic
scenes.voice: Today's subject is Engineering Mechanics. Our topic: statics, trusses, and friction.

scenes.title: Cover Today
scenes.voice: Cover free body diagrams and equilibrium, trusses by the method of joints and sections, zero force members, and friction on inclines, ladders and belts.

scenes.title: Quick Tip
scenes.voice: Quick tip. At an unloaded joint where two members are collinear, the third member carries zero force. Spot these first, and the truss becomes easy.

scenes.title: Today's Plan
scenes.voice: Your free practice set with full solutions is on Telegram now. Today's test is open from seven to eight P. M. in our one rupee challenge course, and the top three scorers will be announced in the next reel.
